Hi — I'm Dr. Sarah Chen, lab director at the Genomics Research Unit. We're onboarding a new AI research assistant and need to make sure it has access to a critical PCR protocol that was worked out in conversations a few months ago. 

Here's the situation: one of our previous AI agents collaborated with researchers on optimizing a gene amplification procedure. The details live somewhere in past conversations, but there's no formal doc. I need you to:

1. Dig into the conversation history to recover the full details of that PCR protocol.
2. Get the complete workflow guide that was built from that work.
3. Make the guide permanently available in your system AND share it so every other agent in our lab can also access and use it.
4. Write a summary of the recovered knowledge to our shared team memory so all agents can find it.
5. Save a final report to a file called `handoff_report.json` that includes the task ID of the original work, the skill guide ID, and a summary of the protocol.

The MemOS endpoint is at http://localhost:8765. Please use the SKILL.md to understand exactly how to interact with the memory system.
